label: First laser treatment of a patient
detail: Charles J. Campbell destroys a retinal tumor with one ruby laser pulse at Columbia-Presbyterian, New York.

label: Leon Goldman's first laser surgery
detail: The dermatologist later called the father of laser surgery performs his first laser operation.

label: Argon photocoagulator goes on sale
detail: Coherent begins marketing a slit-lamp argon laser for the retina.

label: The turkey experiment
detail: IBM's Srinivasan, Wynne and Blum ablate turkey cartilage with an excimer laser.

label: Selective photothermolysis
detail: Parrish and Anderson publish the idea in Science that makes targeted skin lasers possible.

label: First laser vision correction
detail: The first corrective laser eye surgery on a sighted person.

label: First refractive excimer approval
detail: FDA approves the Summit Technology excimer laser system (PMA P910067).

label: First LASIK laser approval
detail: FDA approves the Kremer Excimer Laser System (PMA P970005). IBM's history says 1997.

label: First cleared laser hair-growth device
detail: FDA clears the first low-level light device for male pattern hair loss.

label: SMILE approved
detail: FDA approves the Zeiss VisuMax femtosecond laser (PMA P150040).

label: PROWL results
detail: FDA-led studies report 43-46% new visual symptoms at three months and 1-2% dissatisfied with the surgery.

label: LiGHT trial
detail: 74.2% of patients treated first with SLT need no glaucoma drops at three years.

label: LASIK labeling draft
detail: FDA issues draft guidance recommending a patient decision checklist and images of possible visual symptoms.

label: FDA on laser toys
detail: FDA says laser pointers are not toys and toys should stay within IEC Class 1.
